sections.t: Rest day as planned, with only a 2.8 km recovery walk. Good start to week 2.

Lower A: hip thrust 4x6-10, squat 3x6-10, Bulgarian split squat 3x8-12, hip abduction 3x15-20, lying leg raise 3x10-15. No run today. If you hit 10 reps on all four hip thrust sets last Tuesday, add a little weight today.

Lifting day, so spread the 130 g protein across four meals of about 30-35 g each within 1,750 kcal. Try a Big omelette on toast for breakfast, a Tuna rice bowl after training, and Hake with lentils for dinner.
Your longest run in the past 30 days is 3.0 km, so keep Sunday's long run at about 3.3 km rather than the planned 3.6 km.
